messages:
Alex (sec-eng): Heads up — I'm proposing we change service debug log retention from 365d -> 90d for hosted customers, and move long-term archival to a cold bucket behind an export job. Reason: token volume + cost. Also want to tighten who can pull raw logs from the SIEM and use KMS envelope keys for exports. PTAL and shout any blockers.

Mei L.: Noted. Two quick asks: 1) what's the RBAC proposal for live-log access? 2) how will we handle eDiscovery / legal holds? @Irene (compliance) FYI

Jordan - Infra: For RBAC we can add a new IAM group `sec-logs-read` + restrict `roles/logging.viewer` to that group on the log export sink. For the SIEM export proxy, we should use a service account with only `cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on the key. Envelope example:

```
export_sink:
  destination: \"projects/redwood/locations/global/buckets/siem-exports\"
  filter: \"resource.type=(gce_instance OR k8s_container) AND severity>=NOTICE\"
  transform: \"drop_fields: [request.headers.authorization, user.email]\"
  kms_key: \"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/siem/cryptoKeys/exports-key\"
```

Samir G.: 90d might break retention for regulated customers (financial) — they require 1yr for auth events. We need an exception flow and per-customer retention tag. Also need to document retention in SLA annex.

Irene (compliance): Agreed with Samir. Proposal: default 90d for debug+app logs, 365d for auth/security events, and an opt-in longer-retention per contract. Please add a `log_tier` label: `security|audit|debug|metrics` so policy enforcement can be automated.

Alex (sec-eng): OK — plan: implement 90d default, 365d for `log_tier=audit|security`, and add contract exceptions via `retention.override=true` tag scoped to org. I'll draft PR for retention policy + RBAC changes. Who can review KMS ACLs? @Jordan - Infra @Mei L.

Mei L.: I'll review IAM bindings. Quick note: avoid granting bind on whole project; scope to export sink bucket. Also add a read-only \"incident responder\" role mapping to limit to `last_30d` via SIEM view if possible.

Jordan - Infra: I'll draft terraform for sink + kms key + IAM. For SIEM filtering, recommend we slice exports by `log_tier` to separate cold vs hot sinks — cheaper and simpler.

kms-bot: Reminder: key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/siem/cryptoKeys/exports-key` has rotation scheduled in 30d. Rotate only after verifying sink decryptors updated. :warning:

Samir G.: Add eDiscovery / legal hold endpoint: retention overrides should be applied by `compliance-team` service account only, with audit logs for changes.

Irene (compliance): Also require monthly audit reports of who accessed `raw_logs` and `siem-exports` — include automated alert if access by non `sec-logs-read` group.

Alex (sec-eng): Cool. I'll open two PRs: 1) policy + terraform for sink/kms/rbac, 2) SIEM export transform + retention TTLs. Targeting canary deploy next week. Reviewers: @Mei L., @Jordan - Infra, @Irene (compliance). Any objections?

Mei L.: No objections. :thumbsup:

Jordan - Infra: 👍

Irene (compliance): Fine from compliance side.

Alex (sec-eng): Thanks — will ping when PRs are up.
